Fixed the hyperlink nesting bug in `Style._add`.

The later-applied style now takes precedence for both the link URL and link ID, matching the behavior of colors and other attributes. Existing style and markup tests pass.

final_text:
Fixed the hyperlink nesting bug in `Style._add`.

The later-applied style now takes precedence for both the link URL and link ID, matching the behavior of colors and other attributes. Existing style and markup tests pass.
